title: RWA: $365B committed vs $38B distributed — the gap that makes distribution integrity the question
description: Everyone quotes the tokenization market at $38B; the committed pipeline reads far higher. Council of AI's distribution-integrity axis exists precisely to answer 'is the marketed value really on-chain?'
body: The spread. Independent analysis (KuCoin Insight RWA series, Aug 2026) puts on-chain distributed value near $38.2B across Ethereum, BNB Chain and Solana — while widely quoted market figures count a much larger committed/announced pipeline.

Why the gap matters. 'Distributed' and 'committed' are different evidential classes. Procurement, custody and underwriting decisions depend on which one is real, at which location, under which representation.

What we measure. Our distribution-integrity axis tracks representation-vs-underlying reconciliation as coverage: named protocols, verified+attested rows, and not-located rows — each honestly UNMEASURED where no rubric exists yet. We do not invent a score for a question we have not answered.

The standard. When a protocol claims distribution, ask: on-chain location, verifiable attestation, underlying reserve match. Our RWA registry publishes the row-level state; the signed card is the verifiable answer.
